description: Stage 4 measurement runs of the 15 SQAF functional scenarios (18 tests: TC3 has 3 data-driven cases and TC9 has 2) on Chromium. Values extracted from the Playwright JSON reporter and the SQAF failure classification of each run. Raw reports are NOT versioned: they contain the synthetic e-mails of the test accounts in their cleanup attachments.

conditions.evidencePolicy: general (E1) for suites without accounts; CREDENTIAL_SAFE_EVIDENCE (no trace, no video, screenshot on failure) for the 8 suites with accounts

code.fingerprintMethod: first 16 hex chars of sha256(git diff + contents of the untracked files, sorted by path), taken before run-1; the code did not change between runs

passRateExcludingInfrastructure.criterion: passed / (executions - executions failed with an infrastructure/* classification). It is NOT the observed pass rate: it only says that no execution unaffected by the SUT failed. The infrastructure failures stay in every other figure.

scenarioLevel.note: A scenario run passes when every data-driven case of the scenario passes in that run (TC3 has 3 cases, TC9 has 2).

aggregate.stabilityAcrossRuns: With retries 0 there can be no flaky result. Stability is measured across runs: a scenario is stable when it passes in the 3 runs.

accounts.note: fixtureInstances counts testUser/newUserData instances; an account exists in the SUT only if its creation succeeded (deleteOutcome "deleted" proves it existed; "not-found" means it was deleted through the UI or never created). The manual verification is API 14 (read-only) after the 3 runs.

e0Comparison.method: E0 official series 2 (run-04..run-06, 2026-11-15, baseline project) against the equivalent SQAF case of the 3 E4.4 runs. Durations of SQAF are those of PASSED executions. Conditions differ (see caveats).
caveats: Different days and SUT load: E0 on 2026-11-15, E4.4 on 2026-11-16.
SQAF assertions are stronger (exact product values, URLs, cleanup through the API) and every page wait includes the anti-bot guard and the readiness check.
SQAF applies its evidence policy (trace retained on failure for suites without accounts); E0 records no evidence.
TC1 in SQAF also deletes the account again through the API and verifies its absence (2 extra API calls), and it is the first test of each run (it includes the browser start).
E0 has one case for TC3 and TC9; SQAF has 3 and 2 data-driven cases: only the equivalent case is compared.

method.loc: non-blank lines that are not // or block/JSDoc comment lines
method.selectorCalls: occurrences of .locator( .getBy*( .$( .$$( in the spec text
method.pageObjectMembersUsed: distinct Page Object / component / flow members referenced by the spec (components such as header count once whatever page they are reached from)
method.reuse: a member is reused when two or more scenarios reference it
method.changeImpact: files of src/pages whose code (comments excluded) contains the selector; scenarios whose specs reach it through a Page Object member; lines of baseline.spec.ts that contain it

changeImpact.change: "Add to cart" of a product card
